benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Athletics
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on an athletics task.

benefits.name: Projectile Weapon Damage
benefits.description: You inflict +1 damage with ranged projectile weapons.

system.description: As a rigellian, you are a 7-foot (2 m) tall humanoid covered in thick fur. Rigellians are renowned for their strength, loyalty, and roaring language. Most rigellians are peaceful and enjoy life on a technologically advanced homeworld orbiting a distant blue supergiant star. While you may share the sense of honor most of your kind possess, you've probably left home behind to pursue adventure in the wider galaxy.
